brief.instructions:
Tell the owner where the item stands in five lines or fewer.
Ask the clarifying questions you need. Record each new one with `flow item question --text "..."`. To ask a question already open on the item, run `flow item question --ask <Q id>`.
If you have none, run `flow item question --none`. Then run `flow next` and end your reply.

align.instructions:
Save each answer with `flow item answer <Q id> --text "..."` (or `--defer`, `--withdraw`).
Did the owner confirm your understanding? Run `flow next --decision aligned` or `flow next --decision not-aligned`.
